about_the_game:
Cryptadia Village is a 2D RPG where you follow quests to save a village from dark spirits. Explore an interactive world filled with puzzles and side quests, engage with villagers, and uncover the mysteries of a cozy, magical land full of adventure.

Key Features

  • Use point-and-click to interact with your surroundings.

  • Complete main and side quests.

  • Immerse yourself in a charming, cozy world full of magic and mystery.

  • Discover hidden areas and Easter eggs throughout the village.

Message from the developer

Hi! I’m LiviaCryptadia, the creator of Cryptadia Village. This is my very first game, and I’m incredibly excited to finally share it with the world!

I originally started using RPG Maker MZ’s one-month trial just for fun, but I quickly realized how many creative possibilities it offered. That inspired me to really dive in, put in the work, and fully develop a game I would personally love to play.

Cryptadia Village reflects the kind of experience I enjoy: a short, cozy RPG with lots of charm. You can interact with your surroundings and Elena, the protagonist, often reacts with cute comments (and sometimes even Kaomojis, because… well, they’re adorable ⸜(⸝⸝⸝´꒳`⸝⸝⸝)⸝).

The game isn’t long, but that’s something I value too, especially with a busy schedule. I started making this game back in high school, and now I’m publishing it during the summer after graduation. I hope you enjoy this little adventure as much as I loved making it!
